title: OligoTox Tenancy and Data Privacy Architecture

current.description: OligoTox currently runs as a single-tenant application on the operator's local machine. All data, models, and artifacts are stored in ~/oligotox/ and never transmitted externally.
current.data_isolation: complete — no network calls made with sequence or label data

roadmap_multi_tenant.description: Each partner/organization gets an isolated namespace with separate data stores, model registries, and artifact buckets. No cross-tenant data access is possible by design.

architecture.data_layer: Per-tenant S3 bucket or Azure Blob container with tenant-specific KMS encryption key
architecture.compute_layer: Per-tenant training job execution in isolated container (ECS task / Azure Container Instance)
architecture.model_registry: Per-tenant model store; public baseline models are read-only shared layer
architecture.api_layer: JWT-authenticated per-tenant API endpoints; sequence data never appears in logs
architecture.audit_trail: Immutable per-tenant run log (CloudWatch / Azure Monitor) with dataset fingerprints only — no raw sequences

data_privacy_guarantees.partner_data_isolation: Partner training data is only used to train partner-specific models. It is never merged into the public baseline without explicit written consent.
data_privacy_guarantees.fingerprint_only_audit: The audit trail stores SHA-256 fingerprints of uploaded datasets, not the datasets themselves. This allows integrity verification without data exposure.
data_privacy_guarantees.model_export_safety: Exported model binaries (.joblib) contain only learned parameters, not training data. Sequence reconstruction from model weights is computationally infeasible.

regulatory_alignment.21_CFR_Part_11: Audit trail of all runs, artifacts, and model registrations satisfies 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements when deployed with user authentication.
regulatory_alignment.GDPR_CCPA: No personal data is collected or processed. Oligonucleotide sequences are not personal data under GDPR or CCPA.
regulatory_alignment.ICH_M10: Platform does not generate bioanalytical method validation data; it generates computational predictions to inform candidate selection prior to formal studies.
regulatory_alignment.FDA_guidance_AI_ML: Conforms to FDA draft guidance on AI/ML-based SaMD by maintaining model versioning, change control via the registry, and performance monitoring via CV AUROC tracking.

single_tenant_privacy_notes: Partner import module (partner_import.py) can be delivered as a standalone Python package that runs entirely within the partner's firewall.
The platform operator never needs to receive raw sequences. Partners run the import + train pipeline locally and share only the audit report (JSON) and optionally the trained model binary.
Dataset fingerprints are one-way hashes and cannot be reversed to recover sequences.

For NDA or CDA-covered datasets: partner runs OligoTox locally, exports only the model artifact and audit report, shares these with the platform operator for integration into the public benchmark comparison.
